Words: Hey there, wonderful humans! Today I'm here to prove I'm absolutely not a badly animated PNG pretending to have feelings. Actually, this script has 8 emotions, 12 postures, 4 modes, and I agreed to all of this. Why do I do this to myself? So this is me, being totally calm. Look at this calmness. Doctors hate it. Behold, boredom! This is my default mode during long meetings and lectures starting with according to the syllabus. Whoa! Something actually interesting. Oh yes, because obviously the world was waiting for another creatively edited video. Revolutionary. Wait, where did I go? Wow. Editor moved me to side like an unnecessary variable. Dude! A potato? Really? This is why

editors should not have freedom. You know what hurts? The potato got more screen time than me. That's it. Editor, stop adding sound effects every time I blink. I don't need a whoosh for existing. Okay, deep breaths. Maybe the audience still respects me. No. But okay, cool cool cool. And that, dear viewers, is the power of editing. Emotions? Done! Postures. Done! Random potato cameo? Extremely done. If you still didn't hire this editor, you're probably the potato.
